[EN] It's not just the warthogs.
The forest is a mess.

The beautiful landscape of Heartwood no longer exists. Tria is done for.

The beauty of nature only exists in our memories now.
[ES] No son solo los jabalíes.
El bosque es un desastre.

El hermoso paisaje de Heartwood ya no existe. Tria está acabada.

La belleza de la naturaleza solo existe en nuestros recuerdos ahora.
